## Germán Eduardo Barriga González

**PhD in Chemistry · Teacher of Chemistry and Natural Sciences**  
**Full professor, Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Basic Sciences, UMCE**

Faculty member of the Department of Chemistry at the Metropolitan University of Educational Sciences since 2017. His work combines organic synthesis, the study of free radicals and antioxidants, and computational chemistry with initial teacher education and chemical education. He researches molecular reactivity, laboratory learning experiences and digital resources for science teaching, including modeling and 3D printing.

[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9628-2414) · [Institutional email](mailto:german.barriga@umce.cl)

## Research areas

- Organic synthesis and characterization of nitrones and other compounds with potential biological activity.
- Free radicals, antioxidants and electron spin resonance.
- Chemical reactivity through computational models and conceptual and spin-polarized density functional theory.
- Chemical education, experimental learning and initial teacher education.
- Digital technologies, modeling and 3D printing for science teaching.
- Didactic innovation, diversity and interdisciplinarity in science education.

## Recent highlighted projects

- **2026 · MAPEX** (26-2026-IED): *Mapping experimental learning: trajectories, digital traces and spatial profiles in chemistry laboratories*. Co-investigator; ongoing.
- **2025 · Science in 3D** (02-2025-LICi): *Pedagogical innovation for chemistry teaching through digital design and fabrication*. Principal investigator; closed.
- **2024 · Chemical modeling and 3D printing** (27-2024-EFA): *Strengthening modeling skills through computational chemistry and 3D printing*. Principal investigator; closed.
